title: Governo abre casa brasileira para incubar startups em Lisboa (Startups.com.br)
what_it_says: In November 2025 Startups.com.br named ten startups for the Lisbon incubation house: Aiper, Biolinker, Beeviral, 593ican, Hope, SST, Just Travel, SleepUp, Wood Chat, PixNow; chosen from 112 exhibitors with Plug and Play; one floor of a historic building near Avenida da Liberdade shared with Embratur and Fiocruz.
